You can follow the shipment on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

On your KBOX order, Shop····, Georges' offer still stands. That's the Harlo B30 for the $800 you already paid, and it ships by November 30. Just reply yes and I'll make the switch.

Lukas, I'm sorry, the KBOX on Shop···· won't ship. GekkoScience never delivered the stock, so that order is on hold and nothing is going out on it.

Georges' offer still stands. We switch it to the Harlo B30 for the $800 you already paid, with no difference to pay. It ships with the current batch by November 30, 2026, at no extra shipping cost.

make the switch and tell me when will the Harlo b30 will be shipped to me
